task: Implement self-contained typed checked body IR, deterministic encoding, and exact dependency closure validation.
observation: The existing TypeRef term algebra and TypeContext interned declarations in type_ir.hpp allowed building a self-contained checked body IR with zero new type systems. Exact semantic dependencies are extracted directly from IR nodes (Call, Message, FieldAccess) with exact canonical identities rather than source spellings, and DAG closure validation detects missing, changed, forged, and cyclic dependency scenarios fail-closed.
impact: Separates semantic body IR from the shared compiler during Team T's exclusive writing lease. Executable C++ tests verify deterministic canonical encoding (independent of formatting and variable naming), malformed IR rejection, and all six dependency closure scenarios with zero modifications to src/moss.cpp.

resolution.summary: H0 independent checked body IR and H1 dependency model implemented and verified with executable C++ tests while respecting Team T's compiler lease.

task: Validate dependency closure and expected semantic hashes for ABI-v10.
observation: In checked body dependency validation, validate_dependency_closure previously allowed an empty expected_hash when the entity existed in the environment, skipping hash equality verification. Additionally, make_checked_function defaulted to an empty expected-hashes map and still marked functions with dependencies as supported.
impact: Stale or changed dependencies could bypass DAG closure validation because an empty expected hash was treated as unconstrained rather than an incomplete contract.

resolution.summary: Enforced fail-closed contract: dependencies require non-empty expected hashes (ClosureValidationStatus::MissingExpectedHash), validate kind-specific canonical prefixes (nominal vs callable), and make_checked_function marks bodies with unprovided expected hashes as unsupported.

task: Wire checked body IR nodes into authoritative checker and validate fail-closed source-free handling.
observation: Integrating checked body IR into the checker required exact call-edge identification at return sites and fail-closed isolation on source-free compiled interface (.mossi) files. Direct calls retain body IR only when unique unspecialized call edges exist, while nominal field access and vector literals retain canonical TypeRefs.
impact: Full A4 checked body IR and hashing support integrated into the shared compiler with zero regressions across Phase 25 conformance, nominal identity, Type IR, examples, and typed semantic API suites.

resolution.summary: Milestones H2 and H3 completed: checked body IR nodes wired into checker, fail-closed source-free handling verified, and all Phase 25 suites passing.
